scope: Read-only existing weather8/source inspection; no render, OIDN, source edits or D/E writes.

scene.domain: scene-linear HDR, already containing cloud/water and sorted rain composite; before TSR/exposure/bloom/tonemap/sRGB

presented.domain: actual GPU final image after TSR, exposure, display transform and encoding; not the raw scene re-exposed by the CPU

hdr_semantics.offline_oidn_input: Use original scene RGB float32; OIDN100 and 50% linear blend are independent offline treatments of the rain-inclusive image. Do not denoise or re-expose actual presented.
hdr_semantics.offline_display: Use the existing fixed EV8 multiplier256 exactly once, wide-C1 then sRGB. Keep actual presented as a distinct display stage. No rainfall-free HDR is present in this retained scene stage.

current_timeline.rain: Each graph execution integrates existing particles by one dt and then emits the new particles. Frame0 already includes that first integration; cloud physical_step is 0. Never claim all rain particles have a common absolute age.
current_timeline.advance: EffectsLane.step starts0; prepare uses step*dt; successful frame publication then commit advances step by1. Reset/still_snapshot restarts at0. Current dynamic weather is not a still snapshot.
current_timeline.camera: frame-origin0; sample_frame=fi; dolly eye+=forward*0.25*fi/(frames-1). Original8 covers the full0.25m in7 intervals. Increasing frames preserves endpoints but changes camera speed per physical second.
current_timeline.frame_origin_limit: frame-origin offsets sampling and camera t, not effects.step or skipped rain/wave evolution. A new process at frame-origin60 is not a continued weather state.

future_sparse_capture_not_executed.config_change_only: Copy the original weather8 configuration to a fresh run, change top-level frame_count only, keep dt_s, seed, sampling, weather and history settings. Use a new contract/capture directory. No run proposed here is executed.
future_sparse_capture_not_executed.capture_effect: Every intermediate frame still executes the full graph, simulates rain/waves and commits history. Sparse capture only reduces retained files and some optional readbacks; presented/mandatory error controls are still read every frame. It is not cheaper simulation-only stepping.
future_sparse_capture_not_executed.sequence_override: capture-sequence-stages names are retained every frame regardless of capture-every. Remove the flag for sparse scene and presented; keeping presented would intentionally store all presented frames.
future_sparse_capture_not_executed.checkpoint_rule: fi % capture_every == 0 OR final frame (ordinary dynamic path; no convergence mode).
future_sparse_capture_not_executed.storage_limit: That number excludes journals/metadata/readbacks; it is not total run storage.
future_sparse_capture_not_executed.no_shortcut: Do not increase dt_s for only8 outputs to imitate1–2s: rain integration, emission per frame, wave evolution and temporal history would change. Playback slow motion creates no new physical samples.

limits: Stage membership is verified by actual retained logical manifest plus source; no per-pixel rain decomposition performed.
No claim that OIDN preserves small raindrops or improves temporal stability; root will judge the actual eight-frame offline outputs.
